````markdown
# relayd configuration settings

relayd reads its settings from `/etc/relayd/relayd.toml`.

```toml
listen_port = 8080
max_connections = 64
```

| Setting | Meaning | Default | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listen_port` | TCP port relayd listens on | `8080` | 1 to 65535 |
| `max_connections` | Cap on concurrent client connections | `64` | `0` means unlimited |
| `idle_timeout` | Seconds an idle connection stays open | `300` | |
| `tls_cert_path` | Path to a PEM certificate | empty (TLS off) | |
| `log_level` | Log verbosity | `info` | `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug` |
````

This page is reference, not a tutorial: its readers are on the job and looking a value up. If you want a tutorial, write it as its own page and link the two.

````markdown
## relayd.toml reference

### listen_port
TCP port. Default `8080`. Range 1 to 65535.

### max_connections
Maximum concurrent clients. Default `64`; `0` is unlimited.

### idle_timeout
Seconds before an idle connection closes. Default `300`.

### tls_cert_path
PEM certificate path. Default empty, which disables TLS.

### log_level
One of `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug`. Default `info`.
````
